title: One exchange across the bridge
subtitle: A question asked, answered and applied — while the slow agent keeps working

messages.label: ask_user('Which day do you want to fly?') -> slow_to_fast
voices the question naturally (runner drains max 3 per turn)

messages.text: Meanwhile the slow agent kept working on everything that did not depend on the answer.

messages.label: next observation drains the queue: the answer rides in as a [PHONE CHANNEL] note
select Friday + morning filter (with a fresh state_summary)
answers from the digest alone — no call into the slow loop

messages.text: The fast agent may not say 'booked': the digest does not say so. Completion claims are gated on the slow agent's state, not on the conversation.
